biography.value:
KORRUN SLAGLEDGER — CR 3 mini-boss. Scalewoven dwarf overseer ("the warden") of the staging mine near Dhul Maldur. Cold bureaucrat: slaves are quota & ledger, clinical impersonal cruelty. Chain dominion — scaleweaving warps iron.

Manual — Multiattack: one Overseer's Maul + one Chain Lash each turn (use both items).

Manual — Chain Lash pull: on a hit the target makes a DC 14 Strength save or is pulled 10 ft toward Korrun.

Manual — Dwarven Resilience: advantage on saves vs. poison (poison resistance is on the sheet).

Manual — Tactics/Flee: uses normi conscript guards as shields, never risks himself. At bloodied (≤33 HP) or when his guards fall: Disengage, retreat into the mine via the chains, sound the alarm. He does NOT die here — recurs at the Dhul Maldur assault.

abilities.name: Overseer's Maul
abilities.desc: Melee weapon attack: 2d6+4 bludgeoning on a hit.

abilities.name: Chain Lash
abilities.desc: Melee weapon attack, reach 15 ft: 1d8+4 bludgeoning on a hit. Manual: on a hit the target makes a DC 14 Strength save or is pulled 10 ft toward Korrun.
